text: {"answerable":true,"answer":"The Growth plan allows a sustained rate of 1,200 requests per minute and a burst ceiling of 2,000 requests over a 60‑second window. If you exceed these limits you will receive a 429 response with a `Retry-After` header indicating how long to wait before retrying. To avoid 429s, keep your average rate below 1,200 RPM or throttle back during bursts, and honour the `Retry-After` value. Also be aware of per‑endpoint sub‑limits (e.g. 10 POST /v1/exports per hour) that can trigger 429s independently of the plan RPM [S2][S1].","citations":["S2","S1"],"confidence":0.9,"missing_information":"","injection_suspected":false}
